meta.name: Send AI-generated WordPress newsletters using OpenAI and SMTP

parameters.content:
### WordPress AI Newsletter Engine

Fully automated, AI-written email newsletters for any WordPress site running the AIS Newsletter Manager plugin. The engine polls your site hourly, gathers fresh news from five sources, has AI curate and summarize the best stories, generates a feature image, and delivers a branded HTML issue to your subscribers through your own SMTP.

### How it works
1. Hourly poll of your site's /due endpoint finds newsletters ready to send
2. Five parallel sources (Reddit, Google News, Yahoo Sports, NCAA, BBC) are fetched and normalized
3. AI selects and summarizes articles; a feature image is generated and uploaded to your media library
4. A branded HTML issue is built and sent via SMTP in BCC batches
5. Your site is notified so the schedule stays accurate

### Setup
1. Install the AIS Newsletter Manager WordPress plugin and copy its API token
2. Add credentials: Header Auth (X-AIS-Token), SMTP, OpenAI
3. Set your site URL and from-address in the "Set — Site Config" node
4. Create a newsletter in WordPress and activate this workflow

### Customization
- Swap the five source nodes for any RSS feeds your niche needs
- Adjust the AI system prompt for tone and audience

Support: support@ais.email
https://automatedintelligentsolutions.com

## Data Collection
Five news sources fetched in parallel and normalized to one format.

## AI Processing
Article selection, AI summaries, and feature image generation.

## Output
Branded HTML built, sent via your SMTP, then your site is notified.
